page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance features 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.c7t.2xlarge in the average performance tier across most compute and memory operations. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1585.0 and a multi-core score of 5889.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 11379.98. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 425.05 GB/sec, which drops to 56.88 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. While the server handles lightweight LLM inference efficiently, processing 135M models at 187.62 tokens/sec for text generation, it exhibits significant performance degradation on larger models. For instance, LLM inference with a medium 7B model drops to a poor 16.13 tokens/sec for prompt processing and a weak 7.64 tokens/sec for text generation.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance as a resource-dense option for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. It is suited for workloads such as static web serving, where it achieves a throughput of 11.69 GB/sec, software compilation, database operations, and Redis-based caching, where it sustains 7.95 million SET operations per second.
